column1: # The words the synopsis screen has settled on -- what is not a person's name.
# Hand-written; this is the file to edit.
# Columns: the Japanese <TAB> the English <TAB> a short form, where the panel
# For the synopsis panel, names of people are not here: they come from
# scripts/summary_chunk.js quotes both into a prompt beside these. A word the
# dialogue also says was not here either, and for the same reason: 総統, 魔物界,
# 大将軍, 天満橋 and 死国 live in that file, where the build repairs the corpus
# from one field and the name check reports a caption that disagrees.
# The file has a second job now and the last section is it. modules/ScenePrompt.js
# cuts a scene's glossary slice from three tables and this is one of them, so a
# row here is how a word reaches the person translating a scene -- and the name
# table is the wrong place to put one for that, because an entry there is also a
# repair pass over a corpus that is already baked. Those rows are people's names
# and dialogue words both, they are labelled as what they are, and they are for
# the prompt rather than for the panel.
# What is left -- the operations, the fortresses, the map, the
# machines -- the dialogue mostly never said, so scripts/lookup_term.js has no
# answer for it and each of these was decided once, in a batch of three hundred,
# and then had to hold for four and a half thousand captions nobody reads in one
# sitting. 滅号作戦 is not a thing anybody invents the same way twice.
# The third column is the form to use when the full one will not fit twenty
# full-width characters: 聖櫃 is "the Ark" in four rows out of five. A caption
# reading back shortened is the panel's width and not a disagreement.
# Every row here is what glossaries/summary_glossary.tsv already holds, checked
# against it row by row when this file was written.
# The rows below are here because modules/ScenePrompt.js cuts a scene's glossary
# slice from this file, and a word no row covers is absent from the prompt: the
# translator then invents an English for it, and the next scene's translator
# invents another. scripts/find_unnamed_terms.js is what finds them and
# docs/unnamed-terms.md is why they are here rather than in the name table --
# a fresh entry there is a repair pass over a corpus that is already baked,
# which is the hazard docs/baked-name-repairs.md records.
# The English is not decided here where something else already had it. These
# come from enemy_party_glossary.tsv (Rudrasaum, Stone Guardian, Brobio,
# Demon King Miki, Grand Marshal Stroganoff), card_name_glossary.tsv (Mix, Dark
# Rance, Motonari, Uzume, Princess Panasonic), place_name_glossary.tsv (the
# Demon King's Castle) and docs/terminology-drift.md (the Supreme Leader's
# Headquarters, whose panel short form summary_glossary.tsv already writes).
ストーンガーディアン
# The same word, written half-width. Every English below is what the row for
# the full-width spelling already says -- place_name_glossary.tsv for JAPAN and
# CITY, card_name_glossary.tsv for ALICE, DD, PG, BS and Rance Jr., and this
# file's own ＡＬ教 and ＤＸの会 rows for the AL Church and the DX Association. 35 of the game's 116
# Latin runs are written both ways and mentions() matches neither against the
# other, so the row that was there covered the scenes with one spelling and left
# the scenes with the other blind: ＪＡＰＡＮ in 50 and JAPAN in 171.
# People, where the tables only ever held the name inside something longer. The
# card table is keyed by a card -- 志津香２, 子供ナギ, Lv30 ポピンズ -- and the
# name table by the portrait, so a scene that says the bare name matches none of
# them. Each English below is the one that longer key already carries.
# Places, weapons and the things people read, from the same tables one key
# further out: place_name_glossary.tsv for Mark and Kaiz, 11_スキルデータ.x for
# Tulip and Sensor Jizo, 6_クエスト情報.x for Holy Sword Nikkou, 9_カード情報.x
# for Portugal, the Escudo Sword, the Rance Castle Knights and the Thunder
# Emperor, and 48_立ち絵名札マッピング情報.x for M Land and three of Zeth's four
# armies -- 光軍 is the fourth and takes the pattern.
# Four the draft spelled its own way and something older disagreed with, and
# five nothing anywhere had a word for. 9_カード情報.x:5096 is 職業 = "The-O City
# Mayor"; the wiki has a page titled Ylapu and none for the other two spellings
# 9_カード情報.x itself uses; ズッキーニ・アウトバーン is a surname on the wiki's DX
# Association page, so Autobahn is the man rather than the road the draft heard;
# and summary_glossary.tsv:753 has Maria's Hirara engine. The last five have no
# answer anywhere and the draft never varied: Bontenmaru, Larerare Stone, the
# Sunrise -- a ship, サンライズ号 -- GOLD, and CG, which summary_glossary.tsv
# 144 rows in an unbroken run at the end of the glossary, one per character.
